compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderne…
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: After Samuel’s death and burial, David goes down to the wilderness of Paran.
observations.label: Paran after mourning

observations.body: David’s next wilderness movement follows Samuel’s burial and brings him near Nabal’s wealth.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 25:1–6 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: National mourning and a new household conflict touch without being explained as cause and effect.
payload.title: David moves to Paran
